svg.text: GET /api/getbudgets — how budget data reaches the UI
Quick overview · follow 01 → 10 · full detail in budget-api-01-get-budgets-detailed.svg

g.text: None — no Redis on this route
MongoDB · every month the user owns
Every budget document the user owns is returned — no month filter, no pagination, no Redis layer and no
The same response feeds the budget bar on the expenses page and the budget card in the monthly-insights

svg.text: Budget data is never cached server-side. The only cache in this flow is TanStack Query in the browser.
